lead: Cameras, lenses and the gear around them, organised as maker → system or mount → model → generation for cameras and lenses, and by film maker → stock → format for film; flash, support, darkroom and accessories are kept to what a good buy needs.

depts.note: Variety at the enthusiast end (camera-wiki axis maker → system/mount → model → generation); tier for everyday video and compact kit.

b.v: medium format > full frame > APS-C > Micro Four Thirds > 1-inch > 1/2.3-inch
b.w: Sets image quality more than brand.
The mount decides which lenses you can use for the life of the kit.

b.v: in the body, then in the lens

b.m: Build, weather sealing and long-term support

s.brief: Archetypes are system/mount families with generations as versions: Sony Alpha a7 (I–V, R, S, C), a1, a6000 line; Canon EOS R (R5, R6, R7, R50) and EOS 5D/1D lines for DSLR; Nikon Z (Z6/Z7/Z8/Z9/Zf, Z50) and Nikon D (D3, D700, D850); Fujifilm X-T, X-Pro, X-E, X-H and GFX; Panasonic Lumix G/GH and S; OM System/Olympus OM-D E-M1/E-M5; Leica SL and CL; Pentax K (K-1, K-3); Hasselblad X; digital M rangefinder lineage M8 → M9 → M (Typ 240) → M10 → M11 and Monochrom; Epson R-D1; Pixii; Phase One IQ and Hasselblad CFV backs. Name the lens mount in each archetype's detail. Trim SKU lists into versions; drop near-duplicate model listings.

k.brief: Group by system/mount; medium-format mirrorless (GFX, Hasselblad X) included.
Leica M digital lineage first.

s.brief: Enthusiast fixed-lens icons as archetypes with generations: Fujifilm X100 (X100 → X100VI), Ricoh GR (GR Digital → GR IV), Leica Q (Q → Q3), Sony RX100 (I–VII) and RX1, Canon PowerShot G, Panasonic LX. Point-and-shoot, travel zoom and rugged waterproof compacts as types. Bridge: Sony RX10, Panasonic FZ, Nikon Coolpix P superzooms.

k.brief: New kind: large-sensor (1-inch to full frame) fixed-lens cameras such as X100, GR, Q, RX1. Move GR models from k3 here.
Types: point-and-shoot, travel zoom, rugged/waterproof, vlogging compact.

s.brief: Tier mode: market-covering makers and test winners only. GoPro HERO, DJI Osmo Action/Pocket/Mini/Air/Mavic, Insta360 X and ONE, Sony Handycam, Panasonic camcorders; trail cameras (Browning, Bushnell, Reconyx, Tactacam). Professional cinema bodies are out of scope.

depts.note: Organised as maker → system/mount → model → generation, following camera-wiki.

b.v: shutter speeds accurate · meter working · light seals sound · optics clear of fungus and haze
b.w: Used-market grading (e.g. KEH, Kamerastore) rests on these checks.
Decides the lenses available and resale value.

s.brief: Icons as archetypes with versions: Leica screw-mount (Barnack I–IIIg) and M lineage (M3, M2, M4, M6, M7, MP, M-A); Nikon F, F2, F3, F4, F5, F6 and FM/FM2/FE/FE2; Canon F-1, AE-1/AE-1 Program, A-1, EOS-1; Olympus OM-1/OM-2/OM-4 and Pen F half-frame; Pentax Spotmatic, K1000, LX, MX; Minolta SRT/X-700; Contax RTS, G1/G2; Zeiss Ikon Contax I/II; Nikon S/SP; Canon 7; Konica Hexar; Voigtländer Bessa; Olympus XA, Olympus mju, Contax T2/T3, Nikon 35Ti, Yashica T4, Konica Big Mini; half-frame Olympus Pen, Pentax 17. Name the mount (M39, M42, Leica M, Nikon F, Canon FD, Olympus OM, Pentax K, Minolta MD) in details.

k.brief: 35 mm only; medium-format SLRs go to the next shelf.
35 mm rangefinders; Mamiya 6/7, Bronica RF645 and Hasselblad XPan models go to medium format or panoramic.
Premium and everyday autofocus/zone compacts: Contax T2, Olympus mju, XA. Lo-fi plastic cameras move to Toy camera.
New kind: Olympus Pen series, Pentax 17, Canon Demi, Kodak Ektar H35.

s.brief: Archetypes: Hasselblad V system (500C, 500C/M, 503CW, SWC), Mamiya RB67/RZ67, Pentax 67 and 645, Bronica SQ/ETR, Rolleiflex SL66; Mamiya 6/7, Fuji GW690/GSW, Bronica RF645, Plaubel Makina; Rolleiflex and Rolleicord TLRs (2.8F, 3.5F), Mamiya C series, Yashica Mat-124G, Lubitel; Zeiss Ikon Ikonta/Nettar, Voigtländer Bessa, Kodak Brownie and Retina folders; Linhof Technika, Sinar, Chamonix, Graflex Speed Graphic, Intrepid; Hasselblad XPan, Widelux, Horizon, Noblex, Fuji G617.

k.brief: New kind: Hasselblad V, Mamiya RB/RZ, Pentax 67/645, Bronica.
New kind: Mamiya 6/7, Fuji GW/GSW, Bronica RF645, Plaubel Makina; take these models from k17.
Types: monorail, field, press camera.

s.brief: Archetypes: Polaroid SX-70, 600 series (Sun 600, One600), Spectra, SLR 680/690, Land Camera pack-film (100–400 series, 180/195), Polaroid Now/I-2; Fujifilm instax mini, wide, square and Evo/LiPlay hybrids; MiNT. Toy: Holga 120, Diana, Lomo LC-A, Lomography Sprocket Rocket. Single-use: Kodak FunSaver, Fujifilm QuickSnap. Pinhole: Zero Image, Ondu, Harman Titan.

k.brief: New kind: plastic lo-fi film cameras (Holga, Diana, Lomo LC-A); take Holga from k16.

depts.note: Lenses are organised by mount (Leica M, M42, Nikon F/Z, Canon EF/RF, Sony E, Fujifilm X, Micro Four Thirds, L-Mount); filters and adapters are tier.

b.w: First of the DXOMARK lens tests.

s.brief: Archetypes are named lens families and icons with mount versions: Leica Summicron/Summilux/Noctilux, Zeiss Planar/Sonnar/Biogon/Otus, Helios-44, Asahi Takumar/Super-Multi-Coated Takumar, Nikkor Ai/Ai-S and Noct-Nikkor, Canon L series and 'nifty fifty' EF 50mm f/1.8, Sigma Art, Tamron SP/G2, Voigtländer Nokton/Ultron, Laowa, Samyang, TTArtisan/7Artisans; Canon MP-E 65 for macro; Lensbaby for effect lenses; Sirui and Laowa consumer anamorphics. Cine primes and broadcast zooms are out of scope: trim Angenieux, ARRI, Cooke, Panavision, Canon DIGI SUPER models.

k.brief: Consumer/prosumer only (Sirui, Laowa, SLR Magic); drop cinema-rental ranges.
Lensbaby, soft-focus, Petzval reissues.

s.brief: Restraint: dissolve 'Other lens filters' into the specific filter kinds; types for screw-in vs square/slot systems and solid/graduated/variable ND; a few market-covering makers (B+W, Hoya, Kase, NiSi, Lee, PolarPro, Tiffen).
Restraint: trim to market-covering makers (Metabones, Viltrox, Fotodiox, K&F, Kenko, camera makers' own); bellows is a type of extension tube.

k.brief: Types: extension tube, bellows unit.

s.brief: Restraint: cut the Godox SKU flood to one or two per line; keep market-covering makers (Godox, Profoto, Canon, Nikon, Sony, Elinchrom, Westcott, broncolor); types for monolight vs pack-and-head; ring light moves here as a type-like kind.
Restraint: trim to market-covering makers (Aputure/amaran, Godox, Nanlite, Neewer, Litepanels, Elgato); drop film-set-only models.
Restraint: drop generic shape-names listed as models (put them in t: strip box, octabox, parabolic, lantern); speed ring becomes part of Softbox; overhead frame merges into Flag or net.
Restraint: generic 'C-stand', 'Roller stand' become types; trim to Manfrotto, Avenger/Matthews, Godox, Neewer.

k.brief: Types: paper roll, muslin, vinyl, collapsible.

s.brief: Restraint: generic head names listed as models become t types (ball, 3-way, fluid, geared, gimbal, panoramic); keep market leaders and test winners (Gitzo, Manfrotto, Really Right Stuff, Peak Design, Benro, Leofoto, Sirui, Vanguard).
Restraint: consumer/prosumer makers only (DJI, Zhiyun, SmallRig, Tilta, edelkrone, Manfrotto); body-worn support stays kind-level with no models.

depts.note: Film is variety (maker → stock → format, discontinued stocks included); darkroom equipment and chemistry are tier.

b.w: Judged on the film itself (provisional, memo only).
Judged on the film itself (provisional, memo only).

s.brief: Archetypes are named stocks (maker in mk) with versions for reformulations and formats (35 mm, 120, sheet, 110, Super 8) and dates incl. discontinued: Kodak Portra, Ektar 100, Gold, UltraMax, ColorPlus, Fujicolor Superia/Pro 400H/C200; Kodak Tri-X, T-Max, Ilford HP5 Plus, FP4 Plus, Delta, Pan F, Fomapan, Kentmere, Fujifilm Acros; Kodachrome (K-14, discontinued 2009), Ektachrome, Fujifilm Velvia, Provia, Astia; Kodak Vision3 and CineStill 800T/50D; Polaroid, instax and Impossible Project film, Fujifilm FP-100C (discontinued); Fomapan R100 and Kodak Tri-X reversal. Order by significance, never alphabetically.

k.brief: Includes Kodachrome (K-14) as a discontinued archetype.
Motion-picture stocks used by still photographers and Super 8/16 mm amateurs; CineStill remjet-free versions.

s.brief: Restraint: merge the generic 'Other photographic chemistry' with stop bath and fixer; thermometer and graduate stay separate small kinds; trim to Paterson, Jobo, AP, Ilford, Kodak, Arista, CineStill.

k.brief: Types: stop bath, fixer, hypo clear, wetting agent, colour kits (C-41, E-6).

s.brief: Restraint: keep market-covering makers (Durst, Beseler, Kaiser, Ilford, Schneider, Rodenstock, Paterson); paper types fibre, resin-coated, colour, inkjet.

depts.note: Owners swap and upgrade these parts; kept to kinds and market-covering makers.

s.brief: Restraint: merge the bag catch-all and the shoulder, sling and waist kinds into one Camera bag with t types; backpack and rolling case stay; trim to Peak Design, Think Tank, Lowepro, Tenba, Domke, Billingham, Shimoda, Wandrd.

k.brief: Types: shoulder bag, messenger, sling, waist pack, hard case, insert.

s.brief: Restraint: battery and charger merge; trim light meters to Sekonic, Gossen, Kenko, Reveni and the old classic types as t (selenium, CdS, spot, flash).
Restraint: hood and cap merge; underwater housing trimmed to Ikelite, Nauticam, Sea & Sea, Aquatech, camera makers' own.

drop.why: Cinema/broadcast cameras are out of scope per the owner-approved findings.
Cine lenses are cinema/broadcast equipment, out of scope.
Photo booths are event/amusement trade equipment, not personal possessions.
Studio camera pedestals are broadcast equipment.
HMI lights are film-set trade lighting run from ballasts; not personally owned.
